workshoptitle: Build Connected Retail Solutions with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: The Seer Sporting Goods retail story, team and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Retail Dashboard Query
tutorials.description: Connect product signals, semantic relevance, JSON order activity and regional fulfillment context in one query.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Application Model
tutorials.description: Help Thomas compare native JSON, document collections and a writable duality view over existing orders.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Semantic Product Search
tutorials.description: Review how Gilly creates product vectors, ranks matches and adds exact customer and order context.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Investigate a Creator Influence Network
tutorials.description: Follow creator and brand relationships with relational SQL, SQL/PGQ and Graph Studio.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Plan Fulfillment with Oracle Spatial
tutorials.description: Compare fulfillment-center distances, product stock and demand-region geometry.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Product Demand Watchlist with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Build and score a retail classification model, then interpret its scores beside business evidence.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Retail Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Use natural-language retail questions, inspect generated SQL and compare answers with database results.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Retail Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Define an assistant with an approved SQL tool and inspect the history of its exact execution.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check understanding with eight scored questions covering the connected retail journey.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
